title: Why Nvidia And Tesla Are Suddenly Knocking On Samsung's Door - NVIDIA (NASDAQ:NVDA), Samsung Electronics Co (OTC:SSNLF), Tesla (NASDAQ:TSLA), Taiwan Semiconductor (NYSE:TSM)
summary: Taiwan Semiconductor's production capability is a bottleneck due to the supply crunch, affecting AI supply chain and causing companies to hesitate on downstream orders. Samsung Foundry may capitalize on this situation with orders from Tesla and Nvidia.
sentiment_reason: The supply crunch and production bottlenecks are causing negative market impacts due to hesitation in downstream orders and potential missed opportunities for companies reliant on Taiwan Semiconductor.
